descriptionChirho: To found or establish something, especially to lay a physical foundation for a building, city, or the earth; active Qal stem covering all persons and tenses.
Active participle describing the one who founds or lays a foundation, used substantively or attributively.
Intensive action of deliberately establishing, founding, or laying a foundation; Piel stem conveying thoroughness or intentionality.
Passive forms indicating that something was founded, established, or had its foundation laid; includes Pual perfects, participles, and Hofal forms.
Nifal passive or tolerative indicating that something was founded or will be founded.
Nifal reciprocal sense meaning to consult together, confer, or conspire; a semantic extension from 'establishing together' to 'deliberating together.'
